result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection controlled by a traffic signal but lacking marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and parked cars near the corners create significant exposure and visibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection fails to designate a clear path for pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the intersection corners block sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside along the foreground and background streets

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads to the existing traffic light poles to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and marked crosswalks. However, the wide roadway and lack of modern safety enhancements like curb extensions or high-visibility markings increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The wide street width increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
